animal_design.animal_accounting: No individual exclusions/attrition map; WB n=5 versus allocation6/group unexplained

schedule.injury: LPS2mg/kg tail-vein injection6h after last day7 gavage
schedule.dose_volume_limit: At unchanged1.22g/mL, nominal doses imply5/10/20mL/kg; this is conditional arithmetic. Group-specific concentrations/volumes are not clearly tabulated.

measured_evidence.direction: Qualitatively less lung damage in three pretreated groups versus model; medium-dose image/description relatively preserved
measured_evidence.interpretation: Actual reported nonmalignant-tissue protective appearance, not quantified respiratory benefit or uniform dose response

measured_evidence.low_dose: No significance mark; not proof of a true null
measured_evidence.normal_control: # P<.05 versus model, not a treatment effect
measured_evidence.scope: Author-reported densitometry, not independently reproduced; no phospho-AKT/activity/causal rescue.

measured_evidence.pattern: Nonmonotonic; high-dose mean exceeds low/medium means
measured_evidence.scope: Combined signal, not separately resolved isoforms or Ras-GTP activity. Lower than normal in some arms is not necessarily normalization.

statistics.methods: MeanSD; one-wayANOVA if equal variances, rank-sum if unequal; significanceP<.05. Pairwise post-hoc/multiplicity procedure not stated.
statistics.normalization: Beta-actin bands present; axis %adj.vol., complete calculation definition absent
statistics.raw_data: No animal-level values or full uncropped blots supplied in retrieved package
statistics.image_to_summary_issue: Displayed representative blots do not permit reconstruction of the plotted group means or dose response. Individual normalized densitometry and full uncropped blots are unavailable. Report graph as author-reported, not independently reproduced; no demonstrated image/summary contradiction.

source_limits: Histology qualitative without injury-score or sampling denominator
No healthy-mixture or systematic toxicity/PK evaluation
Saline injection printed2mg/kg and tissue-storage line80°C left unrepaired

competitive_assessment: Retain actual noncancer histological protection signal; it does not demonstrate respiratory performance, BUB1B restoration or MVA/muscle compensation. No comparative superiority over provisionalniacin/apitegromab, which also remain unprovenMVA.

proposed_assessment.route: Exact eight-herb Yiqi Huayu Jiedu decoction / lung-injury pretreatment histology and protein markers
proposed_assessment.disposition: Retain preparation-specific preclinical histology/marker comparator; no measured respiratory-function, BUBR1 or MVA rescue
proposed_assessment.rationale: Batch 20170320 aqueous decoction was given for seven days before LPS injury in male rats. Qualitative H&E protection and author-reported total AKT1/pan-Ras changes are retained, but respiratory mechanics, oxygenation, survival and post-injury treatment benefit were not measured. Histology lacks quantitative scoring; WB n=5 differs from six allocated rats per group and raw normalization is unreproduced. BUB1B is only a disease-target database/network input, not a measured response. Predicted ingredients are neither batch chemical quality control nor isolated-agent efficacy.
proposed_assessment.evidence_scope: Source reviewer read complete scientific main/captions/tables, all seven native main figures, complete supplementary table text and graphical abstract; only selected supplementary page renders. Root scope is separately limited in the qualification.

followup_questions: Clarify batch chemistry/species and group-specific actual exposure

Test blinded quantitative injury and respiratory function, with a post-injury arm and appropriate normal/toxicity controls
